item.title: CVE-2026-69836: Microsoft Entra ID CVSS 10.0 RCE — Corrected Exploitation Status, No Action Required
item.dc:creator: Harish G
item.description: CVE-2026-69836 is a critical CVSS 10.0 deserialization RCE in Microsoft Entra ID. Microsoft fully mitigated it server-side. An initial exploitation claim was corrected to No. No customer action required. Primary-source analysis from MSRC API, NVD, MITRE CVE, and CISA KEV.
item.content:encoded:
CVE-2026-69836 is a critical CVSS 10.0 remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID caused by deserialization of untrusted data (CWE-502). Microsoft fully mitigated the flaw server-side before disclosure. An initial exploitation flag was corrected to No within 24-48 hours of publication. No customer action is required.

Read the full primary-source analysis at TheHGTech
